queries: WITH player_averages AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp."double") AS average_doubles FROM player AS p JOIN batting_postseason AS bp ON bp.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND p.bats <> '' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats), indexed AS (SELECT player_id, bats, average_doubles, average_doubles / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(average_doubles) FROM player_averages), 0) AS player_index FROM player_averages), compared AS (SELECT player_id, bats, average_doubles, player_index, player_index - AVG(player_index) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS index_minus_hand_average FROM indexed) SELECT player_id, bats, average_doubles, player_index, index_minus_hand_average FROM compared ORDER BY index_minus_hand_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH per_player AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp.double) AS average_doubles FROM player AS p JOIN batting_postseason AS bp ON bp.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND p.bats <> '' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats), indexed AS (SELECT player_id, bats, average_doubles, average_doubles / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(average_doubles) FROM per_player), 0) AS idx FROM per_player), compared AS (SELECT player_id, bats, average_doubles, idx, idx - AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS difference FROM indexed) SELECT player_id, bats, average_doubles, idx AS "index", difference AS index_minus_hand_average FROM compared ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10;
